The chain (verified via the code graph trace from `useCreateMemo` and the callee graph of `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`):

web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts — `useCreateMemo` mutation hook (line 178) calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` (line 183)
web/src/connect.ts — `memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)` (line 197)
proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go — generated ConnectRPC `MemoServiceHandler.CreateMemo` (line 409)
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go — `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` handler implementation
store/memo.go — `Store.CreateMemo` (line 109), which dispatches through the `Driver` interface (store/driver.go)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go — SQLite driver `CreateMemo` executing ``INSERT INTO `memo` ... RETURNING ...`` (line 41)

Note: the driver hop is dialect-specific — equivalent implementations exist in store/db/mysql/memo.go and store/db/postgres/memo.go; SQLite is cited as the one dialect requested.
